title: The doc comment for modified sits on missing_glyph
body: In `crates/acre-gui/src/app.rs`, the doc comment "When the file at `path` last changed, or `None` when the disk cannot say." sits above `missing_glyph`, and `modified` below it has none. The comment belongs on `modified`.
close_reason: Moved the doc comment to modified in crates/acre-gui/src/app.rs (8910a4b).
